text.p: Developed Technology Resource Inc said on Monday that it and Agribusiness Partners International LP formed an international partnership to pursue dairy opportunities in the former Soviet Union.

Under the agreement, Developed Technology will contribute its dairy operations in Kazakstan and its opportunities in Moldova and Agribusiness Partners agreed to fund up to $6 million over the next two years to expand the business.

Developed Technology will manage the day-to-day affairs of the partnership, to be known as FoodMaster International LLC, under a separate management agreement. Agribusiness Partners will own 60 percent of Foodmaster and Developed Technology, 40 percent.

In June 1995, Developed Technology started its first dairy operation in Kazakhstan with a plan to expand into other markets in the former Soviet Union. In July 1996, it obtained the right to purchase its dairy partner in Kazakhstan. This year it received a grant to expand into Moldova.
